descriptions.text: Scroll of Upgrade! Warning: This item has a short shelf life. Maybe it's not as good as getting something new, but sometimes it's better to just take something you're already comfortable with and improve upon it. Kind of like buying your girl new tits. Once you read this scroll, one random, currently-equipped item will receive an upgrade. That upgrade could be small. It could be huge. But since this item has a short shelf life, you gotta do it now or forever hold your peace.

beats.headline: Freeballing
beats.text: Carl's Platinum Quest Box holds 5,000 gold and a Scroll of Upgrade, and a twenty-minute timer appears over it the moment he picks it up. Could he take off everything but one item? Mordecai has seen people try, and the upgrade is never very good. Carl reads it. His Enchanted BigBoi Boxers glow: plus five Dexterity, plus five Intelligence, three more Constitution, and the Freeballing benefit, a 100 percent damage bonus to attacks from below the waist, and only a single layer allowed over his crotch. No trousers. Mordecai and Donut laugh until Mongo wakes up. Usually these scrolls come deeper, Mordecai adds, but the two of them already have a name.

beats.headline: Off the wheel
beats.text: The Wheel of Fortune settles on green, and a Scroll of Upgrade appears on the table in front of Carl with a twenty-minute countdown. He knows the rule this time: don't take anything off first. He reads it, his foot buzzes, and his toe ring glows. The Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk goes from +3 Strength to +10, and from +3 to +5 Powerful Strike, which puts the skill at 13. The closer it gets to 20, the more godly his damage becomes.

beats.headline: A decent one
beats.text: The best prize in the neighborhood boss boxes is a Scroll of Upgrade. They have been good to Carl so far. This one adds +3 Dexterity to his Trollskin Shirt. That is a decent upgrade, especially since he had been planning to put a couple of points into dexterity anyway, but it isn't a great one.
